mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects potentiate perphenazine's anticholinergic properties, increasing risk of urinary retention, constipation, and heat intolerance; benztropine may also mask extrapyramidal side effects initially then paradoxically worsen them with chronic use.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, confusion); use lowest effective benztropine dose; consider alternatives if anticholinergic burden becomes problematic; educate patient on heat intolerance risk.
